newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP sees H2 like H1, return to profit.
newsitem.headline: UAP sees H2 like H1, return to profit.

text.p: French insurance company UAP said after reporting a first half net attributable profit of 860 million francs on Wednesday it expected a second-half result similar to the first half and a return to profitability.
The company said in its results statement the 6.7 percent rise in its first half result was helped by a 14.4 percent rise in the result from insurance, despite a fall in capital gains.

"UAP is getting back to profit and for the first time in several years the improvement in our pre-tax, pre-exceptional operating result is finally showing through in our net consolidated profit," chairman Jacques Friedmann said in the results statement.
"In current market conditions, the group should produce a profit in the second half similar to that of the first, thus confirming our return to lasting profitability," he said.
